pull: Use case: identity-preserve. Create a transparent pixel-art game animation sprite sheet, exactly SIX full-body soldier poses arranged in THREE columns and TWO rows, equal cells, generous transparent spacing. Reference image 1 is the exact soldier identity and clothing to retain: black tousled hair, navy coat with ivory trim, brown gloves and knee boots, brass belt, chibi proportions. Reference image 2 is movement reference only. Draw ONLY THE SOLDIER, no cannon, no wheels, no ramrod, no props, no ground, no shadows. Side view facing LEFT, leaning forward under load, both gloved hands held behind his waist to pull an off-image horizontal tow handle. Six different low deliberate walking steps forming a smooth cycle: left heel forward, left foot planted, passing, right heel forward, right planted, passing. Stable head size, body scale and waist hand contact height across all six. Match existing crisp pixel art, no smooth painting. Body upright height equivalent to the original ~210 pixels when normalized in a 256x384 cell. No text or cell lines. Actual transparent background and alpha-zero corners. Keep all feet and hands fully visible.
cannon: Use case: precise-object-edit. Reference is old cannon hauling animation. Create ONE isolated cannon ONLY, no people, no hands. Strict side view, barrel points LEFT. Preserve charcoal iron banded barrel, brown wood carriage, iron-rimmed spoked wooden wheel, similar reference proportions. Include a short tow handle at the front left and rear right, and a clearly visible small unlit fuse curving upward at breech on right, easy for a soldier standing behind cannon to touch. Pixel-art game sprite matching reference style, crisp blocky pixels. Single static complete cannon, not a sheet, generous empty margins, transparent background alpha zero. No text, no floor, no shadows, no separate loose objects. Wheel circle and hub clear; wheel can remain static in this review.
igniteInitial: Use case: identity-preserve. Transparent pixel-art animation sprite sheet exactly SIX full-body poses, THREE columns by TWO rows, equal cells generous margins. Reference 1 exact soldier identity/clothes: tousled black hair, navy coat ivory trim, brown gloves boots brass belt chibi. Draw only soldier and thin wooden slow-match lighting stick. No cannon. Soldier facing LEFT side view feet grounded same level, stable head size and body scale ~210px at final 256x384 cell. Sequence: 1 holds lighted long thin stick nearly upright in front; 2 begins raising and extending forward left; 3 extends stick diagonally down-left; 4 glowing tip reaches a fixed target at waist height to LEFT of body, small orange spark; 5 pauses at same target with tiny spark; 6 retracts stick upright away from target. The hand is clearly gripping the lower part of stick. Tiny ember only, no big flames. All six distinct useful sequential keyframes. Same costume colors as reference, crisp pixel art no smooth gradients, actual transparent background, no ground or shadows, no labels, no cell lines. Keep whole stick and all boots inside each cell.
